narr: A broken line of thunderstorms brought damaging wind gusts to a few locations in addition to heavy rain in Plymouth (Marshall County).
ev: Emergency manager reports flooding of intersections and viaducts near downtown Plymouth, IN in Marshall County. A nearby CoCoRaHS observer recorded 2.43 inches of rain.
